project_context.scope: Modify existing ActivePositionPanel ONLY to support split Paper vs MT5 telemetry, displaying MT5 connection telemetry (Balance, Equity, Free Margin, Margin Level), MT5 active trade progress (Direction, Entry, SL, TP, P&L, TP/SL Progress), and exact execution gate / blocked reasons when >=80% confirmation occurs.

typography.font_family_heading: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

entry_surfaces./: dark MT5 trading dashboard terminal with split top banner: signal confluence stream left, high-density split Paper & MT5 Active Position panel right

layouts.container: col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 rounded-md border border-slate-800 bg-[#111827] p-3 shadow-xl transition-all
layouts.header_bar: flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800/80 pb-2 mb-2.5
layouts.paper_card: rounded-md border border-slate-800/90 bg-[#0B0F19]/90 p-2.5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2
layouts.mt5_card: rounded-md border border-indigo-950/60 bg-[#0C1021]/90 p-2.5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 relative overflow-hidden
layouts.blocked_reason_box: rounded border border-amber-900/60 bg-amber-950/30 p-2 text-[10px] text-amber-200/90 space-y-1

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Preserve the dark MT5-inspired terminal aesthetic (#111827 main panel, #0B0F19 sub-cards, slate-800 borders, emerald/rose PnL text, amber badges).
2. Split the ActivePositionPanel into two distinct side-by-side (or responsive stacked) sections: 'PAPER ENGINE' and 'MT5 LIVE TERMINAL'.
3. Display full MT5 telemetry when MT5 is connected: Balance, Equity, Free Margin, and Margin Level (%). Show a clean 'Disconnected' state with prompt when MT5 is offline.
4. For MT5 active trades, display Ticket/Symbol, Direction (BUY/SELL), Lot size, Entry, SL, TP, Current Price, Floating P&L ($ and R-multiple), and a dual-direction or TP/SL progress indicator.

5. Highlight why no trade executed even with >=80% confidence: Render an explicit 'Execution Gate Status' or 'Blocked Reason' chip/banner (e.g., 'Confidence 84% >= 80% threshold, but MT5 AutoTrading disabled' or 'Spread 3.2 > Max 2.5' or 'Margin check failed' or 'No manual override').
6. Include all required data-testid attributes for automated testing verification.
7. Maintain compact information density with monospace tabular numerals for prices and financial figures.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, keep this high-density Bloomberg/MT5 terminal feel.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not center-align tabular numbers or telemetry stats; use right or left alignment with monospace font.
Ensure every state (Flat, In Position, Partial Close, Breakeven, Blocked Execution) renders with zero layout shifts.
Always use the pre-existing types and utilities in @/lib/types and @/lib/utils.
